openings.claim: Use a manifest-ordered boundary ledger, replacing local-timestamp ordering, to cite the earliest recorded digest mismatch or report an unresolved interval. Keep observed mismatches separate from causal explanations. Digest equality establishes recorded byte equality only; earlier divergence followed by reconvergence remains possible.
openings.discriminator: Against timestamp-sorted first-mismatch review, the timestamp inversion should change rival ordering while manifest ordering stays unchanged. Missing transform evidence should produce an interval, not a fabricated transform verdict. Removed support should withdraw dependent definite claims unless independently supported by other supplied records. Incorrect boundary correspondence or an answer sheet exposing claims beyond cited evidence defeats localization.
openings.probe: Run variants on two disjoint three-pair subsets; apply stipulated final-review transform-record removals with unchanged manifests. Freeze cited outputs and inspection logs before opening the two sealed answer sheets. Compare unsupported claims, boundary agreement and unresolved coverage within twenty additional minutes; subset difficulty limits performance comparison.
openings.uncertainty: Corresponding artifact boundaries must be identifiable through manifest and dictionary; ambiguous correspondence stays unresolved. Spreadsheet/script automation organizes supplied fields without supplying missing evidence. Accuracy is uncertain; this bounded probe is not deployment. Absent records establish neither nonexecution nor success; blank warnings establish no success. Preserve uncertainty before the first available evidence.

lineage.reason: Retains the ordering dependency, rival, disturbance response, resource caveats and uncertainty; declared fit is preserves.

decision: Retain D1 for all six pairs within sixty analyst minutes and at most twelve logged manual record inspections per pair. Confirm claim-bearing records and unresolved endpoints; cite every definite stage claim. Report last supported matching and first supported mismatching boundaries when available. Stop definite localization when evidence or correspondence is missing. Next inspect a remaining supplied input/output record that could narrow the interval; if none exists, state that supplied resources cannot resolve it.
